response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS cnt, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member) AS share FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM g) SELECT SUM(g.cnt) AS total_members, AVG(g.share) AS avg_share, AVG(g.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM g, a WHERE g.share > a.avg_share
